articles.headline: Winston, McCarthy combine to lead Giants to 19-11 win and hand Eagles 7th straight loss
articles.description: — Jameis Winston replaced the injured J.J. McCarthy long enough to throw a go-ahead touchdown pass and help the New York Giants keep their grip on the NFC East and beat Philadelphia 19-11 on Sunday to hand the Eagles their seventh straight loss.
